summary: Compares two values deeply and null-safely.
description: Objects and arrays are walked key by key, dates by their instant, and primitives by `SameValueZero` — so `NaN` equals `NaN`, which `===` never grants. A value carrying its own `equals` method is asked instead of being taken apart.
Cycles are tolerated: a structure that refers back to itself is compared without looping.
returns: `true` when the two are equal all the way down.

examples.title: Comparing
examples.body:
```javascript
equals({ a: 1 }, { a: 1 }); // => true
equals([1, { a: 2 }], [1, { a: 2 }]); // => true
equals(NaN, NaN); // => true
equals(new Date(0), new Date(0)); // => true
```
